source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Environmental hazards
affected_asset_selectors: Ground: Manufacturing system & Assembly & Soft/Hardware Test Tools & Transport & Launch & Satellite Control Centre & TTC Ground
description: Disruption, damage, or desctruction of satellite infrastructure (hardware and/or software) from natural hazards such as fire, floods, environmental pollution, dust, corrosion, frost, etc. Such developments are mainly focused on the satellite lifecycle phases related to the ground and user segment but can have cascading effects on links and the space segment, especially at check-out.
